ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case is not in the Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue and the Record Type is not Direct Debit or Direct Entry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Disputes - General Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Disputes - Fraud Queue')), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'NPP_Dispute') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue.
